statement_summary: One group program; Finance supplement; plan security procedures
Security Manager designated as group lead, Qualified Individual, and plan Security Official
Annual group risk assessment covering Finance and plan data
Risk acceptance authority; Presidents cannot accept shared-platform risks
Quarterly audit committee report; annual Qualified Individual report
Annual policy and standard review
Written, time-limited exceptions
Sanctions
Supplier security review before purchase, including subsidiary purchases
Annual reassessment of critical suppliers
Annual independent control assessment
Change triggers for new systems, AI features, and acquisitions
Acquisition due diligence and day-1 control set
Holding company protects Finance and plan data by agreement
Monthly cyber risk forum with subsidiary Presidents
Six-year retention of security records
AI approval before use for Restricted data or decisions about people
Unique accounts; no shared accounts
Group single sign-on for every system that supports it
Least privilege; data-owner approval; plan PHI limited to named staff
MFA everywhere; phishing-resistant keys for high-risk users
Privileged access tiers; 2 standing global administrators; break-glass
Service account secrets vaulted and rotated
Same-day termination
Transfers: old access removed within 5 business days
Quarterly access reviews
Remote access only from managed devices
Vendor remote access only through the broker
Password rules and MFA reset verification
Lockout and screen lock
Segregation of duties in ERP and treasury
Report suspected incidents immediately
Severity classification and escalation within 1 hour
Record discovery and determination dates
General Counsel told same day; counsel through the insurer
Decision log for severity 1 and 2
Notices per the matrix; same-day notice to affected subsidiary
Evidence preservation
Extortion payment decision with OFAC check
Payment fraud reported to the bank first
Recovery in BIA order
Lessons learned within 14 days
Exercises twice a year with subsidiaries
Annual role training
Every data store has an owner and classification
Data map of Restricted data
Restricted data stays with its company; Restricted labels
Plan PHI only in approved locations; never for employment decisions
Encryption of Restricted data
Restricted data only in approved AI tools
Retention and disposal schedule
Media sanitization with certificates
Deal information only in the data room
Business use and annual acknowledgment
Annual training, including non-email staff and role modules
Restricted data only on managed devices
Callback verification of payment instruction changes
No unapproved software or devices
No forwarding to personal accounts
Report suspicious messages
Approved AI tools only; check outputs
No AI-based decisions about people unless approved as High tier
Recording only with all-party notice
